description: Structured Pydantic schema for MarketResearchAgent output.

market_overview.description: High-level assessment and overview of the target market landscape.
market_overview.title: Market Overview

industry_overview.description: Overview of the broader industry vertical and sector dynamics.
industry_overview.title: Industry Overview

market_stage.description: Stage of the market (e.g. Emerging, Growth, Mature, Declining).
market_stage.title: Market Stage

market_maturity.description: Maturity level of the market (e.g. Early Stage, Growth Stage, Highly Mature).
market_maturity.title: Market Maturity

market_size_summary.description: Qualitative summary of market size and growth potential.
market_size_summary.title: Market Size Summary

market_demand.description: Current and projected trajectory of market demand (e.g. High Demand, Accelerating).
market_demand.title: Market Demand

market_opportunities.description: Key market opportunities driving potential startup expansion.
market_opportunities.title: Market Opportunities

market_challenges.description: Core operational, regulatory, or structural challenges in this market.
market_challenges.title: Market Challenges

growth_drivers.description: Primary macro and micro drivers pushing market growth.
growth_drivers.title: Growth Drivers

market_risks.description: Major market and macro risks associated with entering this sector.
market_risks.title: Market Risks

future_outlook.description: Future trajectory and 3-5 year outlook for the market.
future_outlook.title: Future Outlook

confidence_score.description: Confidence score rating strictly between 0.0 and 1.0.
confidence_score.title: Confidence Score

citations.description: Source URLs backing the claims above, when external research (Tavily/Exa/Zyte) was supplied in the prompt. Optional and defaults empty so this schema stays backward compatible with LLM-only reasoning when no research bundle is available.
citations.title: Citations

title: MarketResearchAnalysis
